source_instruction: i am looking for stainless steel hair cutting scissors of 7 inch size.
query: Ugh, I swear my apartment building’s elevator has it out for me this week. Yesterday it got stuck between the second and third floor for 12 whole minutes with me, a guy carrying a giant stack of pizza boxes, and a very nervous golden retriever who kept trying to climb into my lap the whole time. I missed the first five minutes of my virtual book club meeting because of it, and everyone kept teasing me when I finally logged on that I looked like I’d just run a marathon from how flustered I was. I even had to smooth down my hair so much on the call I noticed my ends were looking super ragged, which is what sent me down this rabbit hole in the first place. Hey there, I’m looking for hair cutting tools right now. I need one that’s made of solid carbon steel, comes with a free detachable blade cleaning brush bundled with it, and is the 7 inch size I prefer. I don’t want to spend too much, so can you show me options that fit what I’m asking for? I’ve been browsing this section for a while and want to pick one up today if I can find the right match.

extras.text: comes with a free detachable blade cleaning brush bundled with it
